dedupe_keys.name: spatial finance initiative municipal wastewater treatment plant database for europe

description: The Spatial Finance Initiative's Municipal Wastewater Treatment Plant Database for Europe lists 1,490 municipal treatment plants with a capacity of at least 100,000 population equivalent, each with an exact location and, where available, owner, capacity and plant type. The information was collected by hand, validated and enriched from European and national databases and web maps, as a first step towards a global open asset-level database for the municipal wastewater sector, with ownership included so that assets can be linked to companies for sustainable finance analysis. It was compiled by Christophe Christiaen for the Spatial Finance Initiative (UK Centre for Greening Finance and Investment) in January 2023 and is available as a single XLSX file on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: coverage is limited to large plants, the database is described as work in progress, and it has not been updated since 2023. Simulation uses: exposure of large treatment plants to floods and other hazards, and ownership-aware capacity planning. Related records: the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive plant data (data-uwwtd-treatment-plants) and HydroWASTE (data-hydrowaste).
